question_variants: Which courses and degrees are offered at AKGEC

answer_hi: College mein sabhi pramukh branches mein 4 saal ka B.Tech, 4 branches mein 2 saal ka M.Tech, aur 2 saal ka MCA program chalaya jata hai.

answer_hi: College mein B.Tech ke liye 1,320 seats, MCA ke liye 120 seats, aur M.Tech ke liye 72 seats sanctioned hain.

question_variants: What facilities are available in the Central Library

how many books are in AKGEC library
answer_en: The Central Library houses over 1,10,000 books, national and international print journals, automated KOHA OPAC catalogue search, digital repository, and access to DELNET and ProQuest e-resources with seating for 350+ students.
answer_hi: Central Library mein 1,10,000 se zyada kitabein, rashtriya aur antarrashtriya journals, automated KOHA OPAC search, digital repository, aur DELNET va ProQuest e-resources uplabdh hain.

question_variants: What are the Central Library timings
library kab khulti aur band hoti hai

library exam ke time kitne baje tak khulti hai
library holiday timings
answer_en: The Central Library is open on regular working days (Monday to Saturday) from 8:30 AM to 9:00 PM, and on Sundays and holidays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. During semester examinations, hours are extended up to 12:00 midnight.
answer_hi: Central Library regular working days (Monday-Saturday) par subah 8:30 se raat 9:00 tak khulti hai, aur holidays par subah 9:00 se shaam 5:00 tak. Semester exams ke dauran library raat 12:00 baje tak khuli rehti hai.

question_variants: How many library books can a student borrow and for how long

what is the book borrowing limit for UG and PG students
kitne din ke liye library book milti hai
answer_en: Undergraduate (UG) students can issue up to 2 books at a time for 10 days, while Postgraduate (PG) students can issue up to 3 books for 10 days. Book issue and return counters operate from 8:40 AM to 3:45 PM on working days.
answer_hi: UG students ek baar mein 2 books 10 din ke liye issue kar sakte hain, aur PG students 3 books 10 din ke liye. Book issue aur return counter subah 8:40 se dopahar 3:45 tak khula rehta hai.

question_variants: What is the library overdue fine and lost book policy

library fine per day per book
answer_en: Overdue general books attract a fine of Rs 10 per day per book (capped at double the book cost). Overnight reference books incur Rs 20 per day overdue fine. A lost book must be replaced with its latest edition plus a Rs 100 processing fee, or double its cost if out of print.
answer_hi: Due date ke baad general book par 10 rupaye prati din per book fine lagta hai. Reference books par 20 rupaye per day fine hota hai. Book kho jane par latest edition ke sath 100 rupaye processing fee deni hoti hai.
source_title: AKGEC Central Library Fine and Penalties Policy

question_variants: What is the process for lost ID card and duplicate ID card fee

answer_hi: ID card kho jane par Senior Librarian ko soochit karein, Director General ya Director ko written application dein aur duplicate PVC ID card ke liye 300 rupaye fine jama karein. Damaged card replacement fee 150 rupaye hai.

question_variants: How can I get admission in B.Tech at AKGEC

how are B.Tech seats filled at AKGEC

direct admission B.Tech
answer_en: B.Tech admissions are primarily conducted through Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC) based on candidate JEE Main ranks. Direct or management quota admissions are processed as per AKTU/state government guidelines.
answer_hi: B.Tech admissions mukhya roop se JEE Main rank ke aadhar par UPTAC counselling ke dwara hote hain. Management quota admissions AKTU aur rajya sarkar ke niyamawali ke anuroop kiye jaate hain.

question_variants: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at AKGEC
B.Tech ke liye eligibility kya hai
minimum marks required for B.Tech admission
12th percentage required for AKGEC admission
answer_en: Candidates must have passed 10+2 examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry, Biotechnology, or Computer Science, securing a minimum of 45% aggregate marks (40% for reserved categories).
answer_hi: Candidates ka Physics aur Mathematics ke sath Chemistry/Biotech/CS mein 10+2 pass hona anivarya hai, jisme kam se kam 45% aggregate marks (reserved categories ke liye 40%) hone chahiye.

question_variants: Is lateral entry admission available for B.Tech 2nd year
diploma ke baad direct 2nd year B.Tech admission hota hai kya

answer_en: Yes, candidates who hold a 3-year AICTE-approved Engineering Diploma or a B.Sc degree with Mathematics (minimum 45% marks; 40% for SC/ST) are eligible for direct admission into B.Tech 2nd year through UPTAC lateral entry counselling.
answer_hi: Haan, jin candidates ke paas 3 saal ka engineering diploma ya B.Sc (Maths) mein 45% marks hain, woh UPTAC lateral entry counselling ke zariye B.Tech 2nd year mein direct admission le sakte hain.

question_variants: How can I take admission in MCA at AKGEC

answer_hi: MCA mein admission ke liye BCA, B.Sc ya anya graduate degree mein kam se kam 50% marks (SC/ST ke liye 45%) aur 10+2 ya graduation mein Mathematics hona anivarya hai, jo CUET-PG ke madhyam se hota hai.

question_variants: How can I take admission in M.Tech at AKGEC

answer_hi: M.Tech admission ke liye relevant branch mein B.Tech degree kam se kam 50% marks ke sath honi chahiye. GATE qualified candidates ko prathmikta di jaati hai, jiske baad counselling aur interview hota hai.

question_variants: What meritorious scholarships and cash awards are given to B.Tech students

question_variants: Is there a tuition fee waiver or scholarship for M.Tech students

answer_en: M.Tech candidates securing 65% aggregate in B.Tech receive a 25% tuition scholarship, 70% secures 50%, 75% secures 75%, and 80%+ secures 100% tuition waiver. AKGEC alumni get an additional 5% relaxation on each threshold.
answer_hi: M.Tech candidates ko B.Tech mein 65% marks par 25%, 70% par 50%, 75% par 75%, aur 80%+ marks par 100% tuition fee scholarship di jaati hai. AKGEC alumni ko 5% ki atirikt chhoot milti hai.

answer_hi: Eligible SC, ST, OBC, aur EWS students UP Scholarship portal (scholarship.up.gov.in) par apply karein aur hard copy, fee receipt tatha income certificate Registrar Office mein verification ke liye jama karein.
